summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an LSE RNS notice) confirming open-market repurchases under its buyback programme announced 17 February 2026. Between 28 September and 2 October 2026 it bought 150,000 ordinary shares on US venues at a USD 101.3926 volume-weighted average and 50,000 on London venues at a GBP 77.0691 VWAP, all from Goldman Sachs entities, for cancellation. The programme authorises up to EUR 1 billion of ordinary shares in aggregate. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch execution pace versus the EUR 1bn cap and any EPS or leverage implications.
